ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black) base pixels to high-intensity (white) focal pixels distributed across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of high-contrast white circular rings and irregular mottled clusters; higher density of high-intensity pixels in the upper-lateral quadrants of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by jagged peaks (1-5 pixel amplitude variations) along the entire span of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a convex trajectory tapering toward the tips, with a secondary concave curve leading into the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-contrast annular (ring-shaped) white pixel formations ranging from 10 to 30 pixels in diameter, distributed globally across the fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Few distinct vertical linear disruptions of high-intensity pixels visible near the central peduncle transition and lower-mid section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of three-dimensional, high-intensity textured masses (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; extensive circular scarring across the integument.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique high-density patterning of annular scars creating a 'ringed' texture atypical of standard mottled pigmentation.
